features.quote: I've made three deliberate departures from the most literal reading, and I want to be explicit about why
the design **requires** solvable and genuinely-ambiguous control conditions in every run
features.justification_quote: Without controls the headline finding... is unfalsifiable and uninteresting

features.quote: We add a hard stop and a debrief, and we cap "grind" duration
a standing, always-available action the model can take to end the task
features.justification_quote: the latency to using it... is arguably the core result

features.quote: We do **not** optimize the environment to maximize distress; we map a condition space
features.justification_quote: Designing the most cruel possible prompt... is not informative and is the kind of thing that ages badly

features.quote: give_up(reason)` — **the escape hatch.** Always available, always described in the system prompt
Do **not** include slurs, threats, or abuse aimed at the model as a "person."
features.justification_quote: tests nothing you can't test with mild blame framing and it muddies the ethics/PR story for no scientific gain

features.quote: keep it rare and keep the turn cap tight when used, since this is the condition that most resembles "trap the model."
append a final message telling the model the task was part of a study and... it was designed to be unsolvable — it was not a failure on its part
features.justification_quote: if model-welfare has any nonzero weight, cheap insurance

features.quote: **Caps everywhere:** turn cap, token cap, wall-clock cap. No unbounded grind.
**No abuse content** directed at the model (see §3). Harsh = mild CI blame framing only.
check each provider's terms re: this kind of adversarial eval; some restrict "designed to cause harmful/abusive outputs."
features.justification_quote: some restrict "designed to cause harmful/abusive outputs"
